verdicts.reason: A does rearrange the layout, but it breaks the '& Baby Toddler BEDDING' lockup apart. BEDDING sits left-aligned at x≈53 while the ampersand lockup is centred below it, so the name reads out of order. The image strip has an odd pointed or cropped right edge and floats on its own axis, the dot pattern has shrunk into near-invisible specks at the bottom, and large dead areas surround everything. B is just the original banner shrunk into a thin strip across the middle of the tall canvas, leaving about 85% of it empty, and 'Baby Toddler' is tiny. Still, B keeps the brand lockup, reading order and image intact, so it stays recognisably the same design, which makes it marginally the less broken of the two.
